20 Photos That Didn't Dot Their Is and Cross Their Ts
People are not very smart.
Published 8 minutes ago in Funny
Sometimes the solution is right there. And sometimes it’s… a chair. Today we’re all about making fun of people who really don’t have a clue, but pretend they do.
A guy treating a Walmart couch like his living room, newspaper and all. Someone measuring on a chalkboard with a chair because, why not? A guy bringing a typewriter into class while everyone else uses a laptop. Dude, it’s not 1985.
These are the people who decided to unfollow common sense in every sense of the word. It's everyday life going somewhere normal people wouldn't go, and you can blame the loonies for that. At least you can get a good laugh out of this, just as long as you're not one of them. So come on, click, and try not to get impatient (we failed).
